decoded.meaning: SPEC{NAME "type" NAME "client", NAME "name" NAME "up", NAME "config" SETTINGS{NAME "role" VALUE u8=0, NAME "port" VALUE u16=8080, NAME "kind" NAME "ws", NAME "addr" NAME "127.0.0.1"}} — a DIAL connection-formation spec
decoded.note: The two value TYPES inside `config` are load-bearing and mixed on purpose: `role`/`port` are integers in a VALUE (0x01, little-endian), `kind`/`addr` are strings in a NAME (0x02). A core whose settings builder can only emit VALUE cannot express `kind`/`addr` at all — the config reader finds a string key only as a NAME child. Bytes emitted by the libtracer reference encoder.
